Liam: Quick smoke report — lightweight prefill ablation targeting mobile tail latency. I ran 3 variants against a quantized 4-bit model with early-exit heuristics turned on.
Liam: TL;DR: speculative prefill + early-exit reduced median p50 token latency from ~320ms -> ~185ms (per-token), end-to-end latency for 64-token answers dropped ~38%. Quality: token-level perplexity increased ~+0.5, rouge/qa spot checks show tiny drift but one hallucination case.
Aisha: nice numbers. can you paste the exact command + env? also what's the early-exit threshold? :eyes:
Liam: command I used:
```
./bench_prefill.sh --model l3-13b-4bit --batch 8 --speculative true --early_exit 0.7 --kv_cache on --seed 42
```
logs snippet:
```
median_token_ms: 185
p50_response_ms: 420
perplexity_delta: +0.52
hallucination_cases: 1/150
```
Tom: thanks. that script ok. two quick asks: (1) run with `--kv_cache off` to see cache interplay (2) run a deterministic seed run (no spec) to get baseline latency/ppl directly in same harness.
Liam: ok will do both. baseline (no spec, kv on) from same harness: median_token_ms 320, p50_response 670, perplexity delta 0.0
Eva: the hallucination — can you dump the prompt/answer pair privately? if it's a safety-sensitive example we should triage. also small ppl change could still be fine if downstream QA unchanged.
Liam: sharing via private thread. short summary: source was an ambiguous prompt, model invented a cite. not catastrophic but worth tracking.
Aisha: for eval methodology — i'd prefer the following: a) 200 prompts sampled from webqa/dev set, b) compute exact-match/EM and an automatic hallucination heuristic (citations present but not matching). c) run both `early_exit` 0.6/0.7/0.8 and kv on/off. put results in table.
Tom: +1. also include throughput vs batch size (1,4,8) for the mobile use-case (small batches will dominate).
ops-bot: ci-bench: queued job 879 for 'prefill-ablation-mobile' — will post artifacts to s3://redwood-ml-bench/879 when done.
Liam: great — i'll kick off full sweep now. plan: 200 prompts, 3 early-exit thresholds, kv on/off, batch {1,4,8}. expect artifacts in ~45m. assigning followups: @Tom validate pipeline, @Aisha craft hallucination heuristic.
Aisha: on it. i'll also add a tiny regression check against our anchor model with 500 synthetic QA pairs.
Tom: if numbers hold, this could be a default config for mobile tier. but let's watch for edge-case factuality regressions before shipping.
Liam: agreed. i'll report back with the artifact link and a short table. :thumbsup:
